query: Investigate SLC29A1 translational risks in mouse for fialuridine

limitations: Isoform choice pinned to canonical NP_001071661.1
UniProt annotation incomplete for mouse subcellular compartment

1_investigator.investigation_plan: The pipeline will conduct an across-species biological risk assessment comparing human and mouse SLC29A1. It will evaluate sequence divergence within critical transporter domains, cross-species differences in subcellular localisation, and disparities in cell-type and tissue-level expression profiles relevant to fialuridine disposition and toxicity mechanisms.

findings.claim: Human and mouse canonical SLC29A1 share 78.4% global sequence identity.
The mitochondrial targeting motif identified in human SLC29A1 is absent in mouse SLC29A1.

translational_concerns: Divergence in the mitochondrial targeting motif between human (residues 1-24) and mouse indicates potential differences in subcellular distribution, specifically mitochondrial compartmentalization, which could lead to unpredicted mitochondrial toxicity or differing intracellular drug exposure in humans.
The localisation layer contains an evidence gap due to incomplete UniProt annotation for mouse subcellular compartments, preventing empirical confirmation of cross-species distribution differences.
recommended_experiments: Conduct immunofluorescence confocal microscopy and subcellular fractionation assays in parallel across human and murine primary cells to empirically determine mitochondrial versus plasma membrane localization of SLC29A1.

missing_data_warnings: Subcellular localisation data for mouse SLC29A1 remains incomplete in UniProt, precluding definitive empirical cross-species comparison of organellar distribution.
